story.title: Our Story
story.heroText: Three generations of beekeeping, one unwavering commitment to the land.
story.chapter1Text: The Lemlih family has tended hives in the High Atlas Mountains since the 1960s. What began as a family tradition in the village of Ait Bouguemez has grown into a philosophy — one that places the health of the land, the bees, and the community above all else.
story.chapter2Text: Like fine wine, every honey tells the story of its origin. The altitude, the wildflowers, the season — each variable shapes a unique flavor profile. We don't blend or homogenize. We celebrate what nature creates.
story.chapter3Text: Today, Dar Lemlih brings Moroccan terroir honey to discerning tables worldwide, while investing in regenerative beekeeping practices and supporting local mountain communities.
